work.title: Untitled (Street Mural View) 1
work.description: Exterior wall of a urban shopfront covered in spray-painted graffiti characters in orange, green, and black, including a snowman figure on the right side. Posters and printed flyers are visible on the boarded doorway; a white concentric-ring motif overlays the door area.
work.composition: wide horizontal mural flanking central doorway
keywords: Mr. Snowmann figure in situ photograph
